ops.oldText: Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
ops.newText: the laws of the State of New York.

input.comment: [Playbook] We replace Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction in 28.1 with New York law, which is our preferred governing law and removes the direct conflict with the exclusive New York County venue already agreed in 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales (with London courts) would be acceptable fallbacks.
input.summary: Change governing law in 28.1 from Singapore to New York and delete the conflicting Singapore exclusive jurisdiction wording.
